## Design

* [diagrams.json: the summary vibegraph enumerate writes](diagrams-json.md) - Schema version 1 of diagrams.json: per subprocess its label, coupling-order histogram, integration configurations and contact diagrams, the optional flavour-group preview, and per diagram its propagators, vertices, orders, configuration and SVG drawing; how ids join it to the diagram artifact and the drawings.
* [vibegraph enumerate, the diagram artifact, and the diagram-importance ranking](enumerate-and-diagram-ranking.md) - Design for vibegraph enumerate (diagram artifact, summary JSON, per-diagram SVG via a feyngraph drawing API on the nsmith-/feyngraph fork), integrate starting from a proc card or an enumerate run, a self-contained integrate artifact (model, param card, diagrams; no compiled program), and a ranking JSON pairing AMP2-share and density-share channel cross sections with the drawings.
* [The integrate artifact and the compiled-program cache](integrate-artifact.md) - What vibegraph integrate persists (per-channel grids and their members, configuration shares, model identity, run card, map choices), how generate checks and replays it, and the compiled-program cache designed but not built.
* [Integrate and generate split by data dependency](integrate-generate-split.md) - generate takes the artifact plus generate-time inputs only; the run card splits into integrate settings and generate settings, each run-card field classified; artifact version 13; the CLI and its migration; PR split.
* [The ranking JSON: vibegraph inspect --ranking](ranking-json.md) - Schema version 1 of the document vibegraph inspect --ranking writes from an integrate artifact: configurations ranked by their AMP2 share σ_c, the unattributed weight and contact diagrams, the sampler's per-channel density shares kept apart, every diagram with its coupling orders and drawing, the pairing rule with diagrams.json, and how the schema is versioned.
* [Release scope and the hard-error rule](release-scope.md) - How the release scope is enforced: every card surface vibegraph does not honour is refused at parse time, never silently accepted; where each refusal lives and how a feature leaves the list.
* [Run inputs the integrate artifact records (PDF set and param card)](run-inputs-in-the-artifact.md) - What the integrate artifact records of the PDF (lhaid, set, member, per-file SHA-256) and the param card (moved parameters); how generate re-reads them as checked assets; lhaid lookup across five tiers.

## Design Decision

* [Artifact format versioning](artifact-format-versioning.md) - How every persisted vibegraph artifact is versioned: what bumps the version, how a reader decodes, upgrades or refuses an old file by name, and why the recorded version survives an upgrade.

## Overview

* [What NLO and beyond would add to an LO pipeline](beyond-leading-order.md) - Components NLO adds to an LO generator (virtuals, UV renormalisation, IR subtraction, matching to showers), NNLO tooling and computer algebra; out of release scope.
